expected_behavior: lint.mjs exits 1 on any documented command that cannot run: a referenced script or reference that is missing, or a citation of another skill's file that does not exist.
A script that imports another skill's script is reported, because every skill must work on its own.
A CommonJS script under a package that declares type module is reported before anyone installs it.
Files that several skills share must stay byte-identical, and a copy that drifts is reported.
trigger-rate.mjs reports rank-1 per skill and flags pairs of descriptions too similar to tell apart.
